messages:
ajay: Quick sync — Acme asked for a burst carryover UI + predictive autoscale option for their Dedicated pool. They want 10% unused burst to roll up to next day and a way to see carryover in the Console.
maria: noted. do we have legal/contract implications for carryover? could affect billing/SLAs.
ajay: yes, billing needs a rule. proposal: carryover as a short-lived soft-credit (30d TTL) that is visible but separate from committed quota. if used, it doesn't reduce base reserved capacity.
product-bot: PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4862 — initial schema + console mockups (wip)
lina: curious about autoscale trigger. predictive autoscale usually means model of traffic + prewarm. are we talking prewarm GPUs or just relaxing batch windows?
ajay: both options surfaced. Acme prefers prewarm for tail latency, but we can offer a cheaper predictive "headroom" mode that only increases batch size / kv-cache reuse and raises model variant.
maria: Launch criteria idea: 1) Console shows carryover balance & history, 2) billing side marks carryover as non-refundable credit, 3) autoscale has 2 modes: conservative (batching/cache) and aggressive (prewarm). Need SLOs for both.
ops-oncall: ops concerns: prewarm = more hosts to manage. we need overflow fallback to shared pools and clear alerting when prewarm fails. also cooldown windows to avoid thrash.
lina: can we define a simple config that maps burst_credit -> autoscale action? e.g.

```
burst_policy:
  carryover_ttl_days: 30
  carryover_mode: "soft_credit"
  autoscale_modes:
    - name: conservative
      actions: [increase_batch_size, enable_prefix_cache]
      cooldown_s: 300
    - name: aggressive
      actions: [prewarm_nodes, bump_model_variant]
      cooldown_s: 1200
```

maria: love that. question on UX: show estimated cost delta for aggressive mode and an "allow prewarm" toggle per-tenant.
ajay: agree, add cost-estimate tooltip. also add an opt-in during Dedicated onboarding (default off for lower tiers).
ops-oncall: +1 on opt-in. also require a circuit-breaker: if prewarm fails X times in 1h, disable and route to conservative mode automatically.
lina: for roadmap, propose spike in next sprint to validate telemetry and prewarm infra (2 engs, 1 ops, 1 pm). if spike is green, schedule canary for a single lighthouse customer month after.
maria: decision: spike = go. I'll draft launch criteria doc and update the console mock. ajay, can you own the billing rule with finance?
ajay: yep, will sync with finance tomorrow and add a billing flag to API (carryover_credit_id).
maria: thanks all. followups: — @lina please create spike ticket; — @ops-oncall please draft alert recipe; — @ajay finance sync and API flag.
product-bot: Created tickets: #PL-3912 (spike), #OPS-1287 (alerts), #BILL-204 (carryover billing).
